🗂️ 소스: HF Model Trending | 유형: model_trending

🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/convaiinnovations/laya

📍 2. XingChen-AGI/Xing4.0-29B-A4B

🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/XingChen-AGI/Xing4.0-29B-A4B

🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf
